purpose: factor-base yield, verified useful rank and regularity screening; no total-runtime selection
identity_gate: freeze full CurveSpec, EC1/UID, registered ICV1 and SHA-256 manifests before any discovery queries; failure keeps stratum unavailable

confirmation.access: only after finalist manifest hashes frozen

regularity.union_or_orbit_base: unsupported unless exact encoding is separately frozen

controls: coordinate or step-one progression at every size
A/A local versus fetched identical manifest

selection.rule: Pareto nondominated on discovery; ties by manifest SHA-256; retain control even if dominated
selection.confirmation_gate: complete valid paired runs, positive paired useful-yield difference in at least 7 of 8 workloads, aggregate useful-yield ratio >= 1.10, no worse regularity when both available

speedup_claim: requires separate ecbench one-public-target paired IC/rho protocol with complete phases and independent replay
